scope: Public official documentation, opened pages and search excerpts. No runtime tests.

fields.name: Dropdown
fields.description: Configured options; shared across all field locations; 500 maximum.

fields.name: People
fields.description: People and optionally teams; configurable visibility and cardinality.

fields.name: Progress (Auto)
fields.description: Subtasks, checklist items and assigned comments; nested subtasks excluded from rollup.

fields.name: Signature
fields.description: Typed or drawn signature; no identity verification claim.

contracts.documented_behavior: Creation-required fields apply at task creation; status changes need a separate automation. Owners/admins configure; Business and above.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test task and subtask creation, API bypass (unknown), status change with empty property, automation failure and clear error.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Default role access, edit schema+value, set value, view only, private. Named exceptions override baseline; creator retention. Restricted fields can be absent from other viewers' saved queries; saving without access may remove such criteria. Form exposure differs.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test read/write/metadata permissions independently, query-save loss, form exposure, formula dependency and privilege revocation.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Simple and advanced expression editors; one expression applies to the column. TODAY() disallows certain query, automation and aggregation uses. Results hidden if any input is inaccessible. Formula cannot span multiple locations.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test null and zero, division by zero, access changes, time zones, circular references (unknown), migration and stale results.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Relationship selector may allow all workspace tasks or tasks from a named List. Optional rollup projects related data.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test allowed targets, duplicate IDs, deleted/moved target, permission changes and empty relation.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Targets may be numbers, binary completion, money or task completion. Goal percentage changes when target progress changes; task shows goal badge.
contracts.proposed_qa: Define target weights explicitly before implementing; test reversed ranges, currency, linked completion and missing target.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Configured rescheduling moves dependents by date change; requires blocking due date and blocked start date. Working-day rule and closed-task option apply. Gantt path limits changes to visible tasks and dependencies.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test cycles (not documented), chains, working days/holidays, partial dates, closed status, hidden rows, permission and preview of cascading effects.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Sprint has timeline, status and effort; missing-estimate warning. Reporting separates scope changes, burndown, burnup, velocity, cumulative flow, cycle and lead time.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test scope changes, effort units, date window, completed work, chart drilldown and distinction from study accuracy.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Personal connections scoped to user; workspace connection lets workspace users search shared indexed data. Role and app availability differ.
contracts.proposed_qa: Consent scope, index lifecycle, disconnect, revoked credentials, source ACL, cross-user leakage and reauthorization.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: External links can have preview/embed or plain URL; Drive can create and attach external docs; login-required embeds have desktop/mobile restrictions.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test unavailable auth, link permission, deleted source, preview fallback, read/write scope and platform limitations.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Connect repositories to Spaces; tasks can reference commits, branches and PRs; creation and sync depend on permissions.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test repository admin setup, disconnected repos, duplicate events, cross-repo references and source-of-truth ownership.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Personal calendar connection; Google Calendar offers event sync both directions through Planner. Do not infer task sync equivalence.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test timezone, recurring events, private events, conflict resolution (unknown), deleted event and revocation.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

contracts.documented_behavior: Configured trigger, optional conditions, and actions connect external services; supported app list varies.
contracts.proposed_qa: Test retries, loop prevention, dedupe, secrets, permission, audit, pending and partial failure.
contracts.evidence_status: official documentation or search excerpt; runtime unverified

connections.note: Lists are documented connection types, not the universe of integrations. No connected accounts or private data inspected.
